description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which establishes a contract for logging components that can output log data to various targets. It provides a method println() for outputting log messages with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable for exceptions.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface for a logging node that outputs log messages to a target. Includes a method to print log data with certain attributes and an exception if present.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable. Implementations can define how the log data is processed or displayed.
